fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code, where the Terminal is serviced/supported from

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: TERMINAL TYPE
fields.description: Type of terminal E.g. ATM, POS, etc

fields.name: TERMINAL LOCATION (ON-SITE OR OFF- SITE)
fields.description: ATM located within the branch (on-site) or far from branch (Off-site)

fields.name: PHYSICAL LOCATION OF ATM/POS
fields.description: Sub-county and county where the ATM/POS is physically located

fields.name: GPS COORDINATE: LATITUDE
fields.description: GPS cordinates based on ISO 6709 standards representation of geographic point location by coordinates (Decimal degrees).

fields.name: GPS COORDINATE: LONGITUDE
fields.description: GPS cordinates based on ISO 6709 standards representation of geographic point location by coordinates (Decimal degrees).

fields.name: TERMINAL OPENING DATE
fields.description: Date when ATM/POS was installed. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: TERMINAL CLOSURE DATE
fields.description: Date when ATM/POS was de-installed. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}
